examples.title: One focal value with a caveat
examples.description: The value is display-size neutral text, never the accent. The caveat sits at label size directly under it and says how fresh the value is.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Spotlight } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Spotlight value="Ends in 45 min">
  {#snippet caveat()}Updated 12 min ago{/snippet}
</Spotlight>

examples.title: Liveness as a status dot
examples.description: Liveness is a status dot and word above the value, so the value itself stays neutral.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Spotlight } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Spotlight value="2 need you" status="online" statusLabel="Live" />
